resource.name: COVID-19 Chicago
resource.description:
NOTE: This dataset is retired and maintained for historical reference only.

It includes confirmed COVID-19 cases, deaths, and first hospitalizations among Chicago residents, recorded by specimen collection date, date of death, or first hospitalization date.

Recent hospitalization data may be incomplete due to reporting delays, and all counts are provisional and subject to revision.

Differences from other sources may result from varying definitions, reporting practices, and date assignment methods.

Data Source: Illinois National Electronic Disease Surveillance System and Cook County Medical Examiner's Office.
columns_description: Case or death date. Blank indicates unknown date. Case dates indicate the date the test specimen was collected. Death dates are the date the death occurred.
The ratio of total hospitalizations to total cases on a given date, indicating the severity of cases.
The ratio of total deaths to total cases on a given date, representing the lethality of the virus.
The number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases reported on a given date.
The number of new COVID-19 related deaths reported on a given date.
The number of COVID-19 tests conducted per 100,000 residents on a given date.
The number of residents per square mile in Chicago, which can affect the spread of the virus.
A numerical representation of the seasonal impact on COVID-19 cases and deaths, based on historical data.
The percentage of the population in different age groups, which can influence mortality rates.
The percentage of the population with pre-existing health conditions that may increase COVID-19 mortality risk.
The percentage of the population vaccinated against COVID-19 on a given date.
A measure of population mobility in Chicago, which can affect the spread of the virus.
